reviewScope: Self-review of an explicitly stratified 50-provider sample from unchanged analysis.json providers, excluding existing large.json proposal IDs. No canonical records were modified.

selection.deterministicRule: Within each classification stratum, sort provider IDs by SHA-256(seed + "|" + providerId) and take the allocated count. The 24 earlier deep proposals were excluded. To cover source-verified parent changes requested during the review, Optum Serve, Verily Health, Leidos Digital Solutions, LexisNexis Legal and Professional, and OwnBackup were forced into the unknown stratum; remaining unknown slots follow hash order.

limitations: This is a cached-evidence self-review sample, not a fresh web review of all 50 providers or a complete financial re-screen.

The sample checked each selected record’s cached identity evidence, SBA match/active status/NAICS intersection where present, current financial screening evidence where applicable, and cached website ownership/size signals.
Matched active SBA-small representations document a current public representation only; they do not independently verify affiliate aggregation, five-year receipts, or 24-month employee averages.
Unknown remains unknown when a profile is missing, inactive, mismatched, or lacks a scoped small code.
The sample is not a statistically powered prevalence estimate.
